title: Sexual dimorphism of the face and skull

queue.claim: The facial width-to-height ratio (fWHR) is not meaningfully sexually dimorphic (Kramer 2017 meta-analysis; Geniole et al. 2015, d ≈ 0.1), despite Weston et al. 2007.

queue.claim: The adult gonial angle differs only about 2–6° by sex (men smaller, heavy overlap). The '90° male / 110° female' pair is wrong.
